# lumen Provider

Manage Lumen application configuration (LLM providers, API keys, workspace settings, ...) declaratively via the Lumen admin API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lumen = {
      source = "lumen-dot-app/lumen"
    }
  }
}

variable "lumen_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Credentials can also come from LUMEN_SERVER_URL / LUMEN_API_KEY env vars.
provider "lumen" {
  endpoint = "https://lumen.internal.example.com"
  api_key  = var.lumen_api_key # an API key in the Admin group ("on_...")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Lumen API key (`on_...`) in the seeded `Admin` group, or unrestricted personal access token (`lumen_pat_...`). May also be set via the `LUMEN_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_prefix` (String) Path prefix the API is served under, defaults to `/api` (the web proxy). Set to `""` when talking directly to the backend (e.g. `http://localhost:8080`). May also be set via the `LUMEN_API_PREFIX` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Lumen server origin, e.g. `https://cloud.lumen.app` or `http://localhost:3000`. May also be set via the `LUMEN_SERVER_URL` environment variable.
